description: Loads the homepage of one public website over HTTPS, the way a visitor's browser would, and reports its HTTPS setup, TLS certificate and security headers (Strict-Transport-Security, Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, cookie flags, mixed content and server banners). Returns a score from 0 to 100, a verdict, the TLS certificate issuer and expiry date, and each finding with a severity (critical, high, medium or low) and a plain-English fix that includes nginx or Cloudflare examples. Use it for questions like 'is example.com secure?', 'what security headers is my site missing?', 'when does this site's certificate expire?' or 'why does Chrome say my site is not secure?'. Input is a bare domain (example.com) or an https:// address. A bare domain checks the homepage; if you include a path, that one page is loaded instead. It does not log in, submit forms, scan ports, crawl other pages or test for vulnerabilities, and nothing is stored. It refuses private, internal and local addresses, plain http://, ports other than 443 and addresses with a user name; those come back as an isError result with a message saying what to change. A check usually takes 1 to 10 seconds. Running it twice on the same site gives the same result unless the site changed. Read corrie://docs/scoring for how the score and verdict work.

url.description: The public website to check: a bare domain such as example.com, or an https:// address such as https://www.example.com/. If you leave out the scheme, https:// is added. Only port 443 is allowed. Private, internal and local addresses (10.x, 192.168.x, 127.0.0.1, localhost, *.local) are refused.

name: check_website

certificate.description: Facts about the site's TLS certificate. Fields are null when not observed.

counts.description: Number of findings at each severity.

final_url.description: The address after following up to 3 redirects.

findings.description: Problems found, most severe first. Empty when nothing was found.

category.description: Area of the finding: headers, tls, cookies, mixed_content or reachability.

detail.description: What is wrong, in plain English.

fix.description: How to fix it, often with an nginx or Cloudflare example.

severity.description: How much it matters. See corrie://docs/scoring.

http_status.description: HTTP status code of the final response.

limitations.description: What this quick check does not cover.

report_url.description: Where a person can run the same check in a browser.

score.description: Starts at 100. Each finding subtracts points: critical 35, high 15, medium 6, low 2. Never below 0.

url.description: The normalized https:// address that was requested.

verdict.description: One-line summary based on the most severe finding.

title: Check a website's HTTPS and security headers
